versions.changelog:
Initial release of the sleep-tracker-buying-consultant skill.

- Empowers users to make informed sleep tracker purchases based on health goals, comfort preferences, device ecosystem, and privacy needs.
- Delivers a structured, unbiased consultation to recommend must-have specs, useful upgrades, and optional extras — no brand bias.
- Interviews users to ensure recommendations fit their individual needs (sensors, form factor, compatibility, battery life, etc.).
- Provides up to five real product suggestions that match confirmed requirements.
- Notes limitations for medical use and never attempts medical diagnoses.
